nodes.name: Get Profiles To Score
nodes.notes: Attach a Supabase credential (Project URL + service_role key). Pulls unscored profiles; real filtering to 'no score yet' is a refinement for later. LEGACY: reads a `profile` table that predates the current schema.

nodes.name: Get Campaign For Profile
nodes.notes: Fetches the campaign row (search goal + KPI weights + hard-filter switches) for the profile from the previous node.

nodes.name: Build Scoring Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds the LLM system+user prompt from KPI-FRAMEWORK.md's rubric; carries campaign weights/switches forward to the composite-score step. LEGACY/ARCHITECTURE MISMATCH: this workflow computes the KPI composite score itself in the 'Compute Composite Score' Code node below (JS reweighting/hard-filter/seniority-floor logic). CONTRACT.md requires this arithmetic to live in the Rust `clitools/scoring` engine, never in n8n or an LLM. Do not reconnect or reuse this scoring logic as-is -- Phase 1.1 already reimplemented and tested it correctly in Rust.

nodes.name: Score Profile (OpenRouter)
nodes.notes: Attach an HTTP Header Auth credential (e.g. named 'OpenRouter') with header Authorization: Bearer <your OpenRouter API key>. Model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free (mistral's free tier was deprecated; lightning chosen over ultra since this is simple scoring, not heavy reasoning).

nodes.name: Compute Composite Score
nodes.notes: ARCHITECTURE MISMATCH (see Build Scoring Prompt note above): this arithmetic now lives correctly in clitools/scoring (Rust, 25 tests, sec.30-32 semantics including the same seniority floor and hard filters).

nodes.name: Save Score
nodes.notes: Only reached when hard filters pass. scored_at defaults to now() in the DB schema. LEGACY: writes to a `score` table not present in the current schema.
